text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"My, if it isn't the Chairwoman. Did you 
come to... cheer us on?"

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Mm. In fact, I have observed your training 
as well!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
I'm glad to see they're putting both the 
constructed course and the VR facilities 
to good use. At this rate—

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Even if we haven't reached our revised 
target yet, we should definitely be able 
to achieve it by race day!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Heh, no need to worry. After all, come 
autumn, we're gonna be the best in the 
world.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Because "that place" is finally 
within our reach.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A dream reshaped from "admiration" into a 
"goal." Now, all that's left is to take it 
one step at a time toward that goal.
